description: An on-chain LLM request/response oracle on devnet (Anchor 0.31.1): users open a chat context, post an inference request naming a callback program, and the oracle identity answers by CPI into that callback signed by the config PDA. initialize, create_chat, create_llm_inference, callback_from_llm and callback_test verified with real transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of GauravBurande/solana-llm-oracle. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/solana-llm-oracle. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and set the admin and oracle identity to the Sol.College devnet lab wallet. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (requests, callbacks, PDA signatures)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/solana-llm-oracle/
QA: devnet proof of oracle callbacks
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Run a devnet oracle service that answers with a real model
